body:
Authored WITH bindings now retain the actual common Relation/Graph/Vectors/Events topology before demand pruning. The public DATA parser/API has been removed; current caller and documentation retirement is still in progress. No compatibility parser, synthetic Result, alternate checker/evaluator or new acquisition/storage owner is added.

Current submitted HEAD: `2e1e7de4e924cf71db64de68bd8d70859a6cfbc8` (clean), tree `55e1c9e72dfc45e499a377ce6398a68de72ff30a`, targeting **main**, normally adopting `2e8fa9308f13de328a6e1eae43b9c16090f4c982` through merge `c4813c6303ba432fd929f45a2bce1af26f096308`. Common Prefix #1522, including Root's independent `ForeignProgram` refusal for Effect binding, is integrated. E diagnostic #1516 is included in this branch; its dependent integration is handled with #1506.

This update closes the remaining Core test callers using old DATA success inputs. Set caller source `b90a1a8e7880b3624456587a3256c7aecbf1bed7` executes JS24/24 and Node29/29 (`run-gVB8NV`); positional source `da13e683189b2e27843c4e74b1a9f43c35c4beb9` executes JS33/33 (`run-2WX8J5`). All used the existing 60s/grace5/non-Heavy guard and observed actual Owner/group/ownlock release. Complete independent Programs and public fixture JSON controls/values/schema/IDs/limits remain preserved. The initial positional `637b892` JS31/33 failure remains recorded: a DATA-only SQL-selector refusal and malformed migrated WITH delimiters were corrected; no product semantics changed. Exact commands, source/tree, raw logs and SHA256 indexes are in `p1-set-current-retirement-execution.json` and `p1-positional-current-retirement-execution.json` under tracked reviews.

Root's separate five-file caller closure `bc738e9b46d75cdb839e8255b6e1a860bddb2d3c` was adopted through ordinary merge `65c102eb4a6fb1ca3894d77d5f0c5357490de164`, with no conflict. Root reports JS28/28 on bc738 (`run-weoNyZ`, `focused-lN4g4G`) and five-file read-only formatting. The merged-source runtime is not reclassified as tested. No old DATA remains in current query_program test callers; explicit retired-entry parser refusals and immutable historical preimages remain. Current public fixtures/examples, full adopted P2 and Local/HTTPS acceptance remain incomplete. This evidence-only final HEAD is distinct from every tested source above; no new packages, Host runtime or Hosted CI were launched.

The new finite connection lowers seven existing calls (`to_vectors`, `normalize_vectors`, `score_vectors`, `vectors`, `to_events`, `session`, `events`) with operation-defined field/value roles. The common Prefix checker supplies Carrier/schema evidence; only explicit bridges permit Relation operators on Vectors/Events. Captured inputs, imports, source origins and unresolved order obligations remain owned by the existing common path. Normal Host preparation and publication stay strict.

An independent counterexample found that a Graph call following Carrier conversion could be removed without lowering. The lowerer now refuses an unlowered call and root dispatch respects the first Carrier operation. Original failing receipts `run-apvvhZ` and `run-ON4Ebh` are retained. Independent JSON controls preserve operator arguments and type checking; expected rows, capacities and order were not weakened.

The grammar/profile, generated compilation manifest and independent current Run preimage are coherent. The full predecessor is frozen separately. Only the grammar-bound identity chain changes; the Values Program/Unit/ResultPlan meaning is unchanged. Three remaining public caller sources were migrated without changing predicates, JOIN bounds or expected values; their Host executions remain unverified.

This update retires current Graph definition/label selection, property/node-hop/edge predicate, keyed scope and direct constructor callers into WITH/GRAPH. Independent complete Programs retain data, label/property distinction, scoped identities, parallel definitions, nullable object contracts, direction/hop limits, work limits and JOIN ceiling10. Invalid presence/type remains owned by the common static checker; retired LABELS stays a precise parser refusal. No Graph API/Owner change is included.

- `283712d050ad822c53cb6d10b00bba1ca4d6aa9d`: JS **8/8**, `run-7ctRLA`, via `prepared-with-graph-definition-selection.mjs`.
- `0c8e429180b2737a79b749f1c5b74a193eaa5844`: JS **26/26**, `run-dNSdHB`, via `prepared-with-graph-predicate.mjs`. The earlier test-helper Debug compilation failure remains zero executed tests.
- `a3c80c2de2edcc6f24dd13bcde8568bcdb821805`: JS **16/16**, `run-wLr6Ij`, via `prepared-with-graph-keyed-scope.mjs`. Initial **12/16**, **15/16**, **15/16** failures remain preserved. Current direct constructor spelling, the exact authored origin query and the existing retired-LABELS parser boundary were corrected without changing product behavior or complete Program semantics. Subsequent formatter changes one file's whitespace only.
- `914597f67bd9d428217be83ea48cba499ba9e2f3`: actual read-only metadata/family freshness plus Node **3/3** import tests, `run-AfEVIH`, via `prepared-with-current-documents.mjs`. Existing generators update four normative imports from exact authored language document bytes; requirement IDs/fingerprints, common contracts and product identity inputs remain unchanged. Full previous document preimages are frozen.

All commands use the existing **60-second/grace-5/non-Heavy** guard. Exact source/tree, raw logs/receipts and SHA256 are tracked under `reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover`; actual Owner/group/ownlock release was checked after every terminal receipt. The submitted HEAD adds retained evidence and fixture whitespace after those tested sources; these results are not new-HEAD Host/package/Local/HTTPS success. No new packages, public acceptance, Native/Wasm execution or Hosted CI was performed for this update.

Projected MATCH producers and their public fixture now use WITH/GRAPH. Clean `b92249c09bd9094aa0ba8c2365c12cb783bb1ea2` executes **JS7/7 + Node5/5** (`run-gGIZ24`) via `prepared-with-match-producer.mjs`. Complete independent Programs change only deterministic binding names; JSON controls, all public case IDs, NULL/typed empty results, full ordered columns, keyed parallel-edge TRAIL, Source predicate id=2 and read2/session1 counts are preserved. Nested WITH/derived-table producers now use the adopted unified query owner; nested RESULT is rejected at the existing pure-body parser. Active fixture/export/selection names use WITH (`--match-with-producer-only`); frozen predecessor grammar/vector bytes and historical case IDs remain unchanged. Public **10normal/7refusal** execution is not performed. Exact evidence is in `p1-match-producer-retirement-execution.json`.

A current counterexample exposed an actual Frontend classification inconsistency: `WITH ... rows AS (FROM n |> node_rows()) ...`, where n is an admitted Relation, returned UnsupportedGraph instead of the established root InvalidQuery rule. One private routing helper now serves root and projected Relation terms, without inventing Carrier/presence evidence or changing the common Graph API/Owner/semantics. A nearer Relation cannot fall back to an outer Graph; unknown sources retain the existing support refusal.

- Clean `c5a5afd6682624f7d0d31d9a1cf4c25122e411d2`: **JS16/16**, `run-mLH8gW`, via `prepared-with-graph-refusals.mjs`, including the counterexample, unresolved-source controls, direct Graph JOIN and MATCH WITH callers. Initial **4/5** reproduced the actual defect; later **15/16** retained the old broad shadowed-Graph JOIN expectation. Both failures and original source are kept; the latter now strictly asserts InvalidQuery. Shortest two selectors/max_hops1, mean policies and all removed-column controls remain unchanged.
- Clean `d64063989890da63af295c2c145bc004139f74a3`: **Node3/3**, `run-Tkm0RM`, via the same prepared command with `--public-fixtures`. Graph row JOIN public source uses WITH/GRAPH; independent JSON bytes, rows, ordered contracts, duplicate multiplicity, Source predicate id=1, shared read/session1 and JOIN ceilings10/2 are preserved. The existing shadowed-Graph public refusal requires InvalidInput. The **10normal/5refusal/1execution-failure** case IDs and oracles remain unchanged. Public execution is unperformed.

`p1-graph-carrier-refusal-execution.json` indexes exact source/tree/commands, raw failure/success evidence and SHA256. All guards retain **60s/grace5/nonHeavy**; actual Owner/group/ownlock release is confirmed. The final submitted HEAD adds evidence after these exact checks; no submitted-HEAD Host/Local/HTTPS, package, Native/Wasm or Hosted CI success is claimed.

Current caller retirement also replaces accepted DATA text with authored WITH in CTE/set, Graph union/subtraction, positional set and composition controls. Nested scope, original Source predicates (`id = id`), JOIN bound 10, NULL extension, duplicates, independent rows/schema and column order are retained. Complete Program controls change only deterministic producer names. Common static Append typing rejection and forbidden nested publication remain explicit; old parser fallback is not restored. Public case IDs and independent expectation inventory remain stable.

Unified Graph public Source callers now use the same WITH input through both SQL and AQL-text selectors. Their complete independent Program retains the original Values, Graph mapping and equality arguments, with only deterministic producer names updated. Authored call/refusal coordinates are counted independently from the literal ASCII source. Retired constructor controls now reject the old constructor inside WITH directly, instead of failing first at removed DATA syntax. Existing malformed-generator and invalid-producer causes remain explicit.

The later public-compile CTE binding branch was unreachable after the unconditional WITH/script dispatch. This unit removes that parallel CTE compiler and its exclusive scope/schema/JOIN helpers, while keeping shared query terms, ordinary set/JOIN lowering, capture, static checks and strict publication. Original source and executable-reference proof are retained in `retired-unreachable-cte-source.json`; existing public compile counterexamples compare against independent complete Programs.

- `54665a96136a6db0528083ebbd55b3ecc3a5b830`: JS **16/16** (`run-KkqKzB`). The unused exclusive helper warning was removed in the subsequent source.
- `4f79dbdfa7f96f7468eda349b08b5ace4bbfa157`: JS **16/16**, no compiler warnings (`run-txmuFn`), using `node reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/prepared-unified-cte-owner.mjs`.
- `d5561f16d709ce6536ff80375c0c4b4af67bed40`: retained NEAREST WITH callers JS **4/4** (`run-8YNTR6`), using `prepared-with-nearest-caller.mjs`. Candidate scope reaches the ordinary public compiler; original pair keys, k=2, dimensions, nullable KEEP and complete independent Program remain unchanged. This is compile/check evidence, not NEAREST Host execution.
- The initial fixture migration `run-MzSry9` remains **JS2/4, exit2**. It omitted two installed input names when deriving generated seed allocation. The original complete oracle was restored byte-for-byte, with independent allocation reasoning in `with-nearest-allocation-correction.json`. Formatter, exact source/tree, logs and actual Owner/group/ownlock releases for all six attempts are indexed in `p1-unified-cte-owner-execution.json`.

Graph equality/difference current callers also now use WITH/GRAPH. Clean `5b5a93e8cc7f65bb7a46931dd72f009958201160` executes JS **13/13** (`run-KFEoVW`) with `node reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/prepared-with-graph-comparison.mjs`; its two-file formatter completed without changes. The independently authored complete JSON controls retain operations and mapping, changing only deterministic Relation/Graph producer names. Graph aliases, ORDER/LIMIT, ordinary checker and exact authored refusals are retained. Original `92e6585f` **JS11/13** stays a failure: two coordinates still counted the old shared DATA prefix. `with-graph-comparison-coordinate-correction.json` derives the new positions from the declared literal WITH source without product output. Three raw receipts, exact source/tree, hashes and actual Owner/group/ownlock release are indexed in `p1-graph-comparison-retirement-execution.json`. This is compile/check evidence; public Host and package acceptance remain unexecuted.

Current MATCH/normalization/traversal-path callers now use WITH/GRAPH. Clean `1cc82ea3389c1cba21002620e06b5fdadc6a24d9` executes JS **17/17** (`run-2JFUCh`) via `node reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/prepared-with-graph-match-path.mjs`. Complete independent JSON controls retain predicates, Graph identity roles, selector inputs, path columns/order, min/max hops, explicit TRAIL and `max_output_rows: 10`; only deterministic producer names change. The four-file formatter completed before that tested source. Original `1d331a57` **JS14/17** stays a failure: three malformed controls expected an invalid Program to be returned before separate checking, while current common static checking rejects earlier. Tests now assert independently traced typed GraphMatch/InvalidBody causes for fields/definition/label, collisions, Boolean predicate, decoded body, selector and hop/mode boundaries. The original sources, independent allocation/ASCII coordinates, exact source/tree, three raw receipts and actual Owner/group/ownlock release are indexed in `p1-graph-match-path-retirement-execution.json`. No common Graph implementation, runtime owner or public package execution was changed or performed for this unit.

Current acquisition, Result and JOIN callers now use WITH. Clean `185a915c60f6b47ccb3a3b5b6a9fb04dc7ec53b3` executes JS **11/11** (`run-ejpUac`) via `node reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/prepared-with-acquisition-result-join.mjs`. The independent complete Programs retain Values/schema, capture imports, source/consumer predicates, two Result boundaries and JOIN ceilings. Bare-schema Graph controls reject absent producer provenance at the actual common static preparation boundary; they are not successful Graph acquisition evidence. The initial malformed negative-test declaration stays **JS10/11, exit2** (`run-8mivVK`); only its WITH declaration grammar was corrected. Original callers, exact source/tree, formatter, raw receipts and actual Owner/group/ownlock releases are indexed in `p1-acquisition-result-join-retirement-execution.json`.

Clean `2634fa7bc873fc59284a19e9c9d22f2e172b07db` executes JOIN chain/Pipe range JS **14/14** (`run-v2ON0X`) via `node reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/prepared-with-join-chain.mjs`. Original ON predicates, explicit max 10, Values, SET/DROP/RENAME and output/order contracts remain unchanged. The nested Pipe prefix allocation is independently derived from the parser continuation and binding recursion, before the enclosing output. Three absent-reference controls now assert the existing ordinary JOIN `UnknownColumn` cause; duplicate qualifier still asserts `AmbiguousRelation`. No scope implementation was changed. Original **JS11/14** (`run-64GyOU`) and diagnostic **JS13/14** (`run-9IYO8B`) failures remain retained. `p1-join-chain-retirement-execution.json` records exact sources, commands, no-change formatter, logs/hashes and actual release. Both finite units used 60-second/grace-5/non-Heavy guards; they are compile/check evidence, not package or Local/HTTPS execution. The submitted HEAD adds tracked evidence only after these tested sources.

Additional Graph row JOIN/Subgraph callers now use WITH/GRAPH. Clean `853bfd6fc7b2b10e5dee9370e92c3531fce00496` executes JS **11/11** (`run-gFzEmD`) through `node reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/prepared-with-graph-selector.mjs`. Independent complete Programs retain selector identity, numeric parameter predicate, output columns, ON and ceiling10; only deterministic binding allocation changes. The NULL-bearing parallel-edge control reaches common checking. Malformed body/empty selector/unknown column/wrong identity contract/non-Boolean predicate/unadapted selector assert the real common static causes. The original **JS9/11** (`run-mlNA3E`) and subsequent **JS10/11** (`run-71pek9`) remain failures; the latter predicted the wrong first cause for an original Reach with missing direction. The source was not changed to hide that omission. Exact cause is `GraphMatch(Structure(Decode(MissingField)))`, independently traced to the common traversal required field. The one-file whitespace formatter, exact sources/trees, all raw receipts/hashes and actual releases are retained in `p1-graph-selector-retirement-execution.json`.

Clean `695add75e3670513013973e80f0c430e6bab9a9e` executes Source predicate/JOIN ceiling/INFER input and unchanged Effect/Result controls JS **9/9** (`run-lZ640a`) via `node reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/prepared-with-composition-input.mjs`; two-file formatter completes without changes. Original Source `id = id` remains exactly once, never true; JOIN max10 and Context max9 refusal remain unchanged. INFER input contract spelling/key/type, original source-free form and nullable Values controls are retained. Only two retired DATA wrappers changed; D/A Owner implementations and the Effect/assertion controls were not edited. Exact sources, receipts/hashes and actual Owner/group/ownlock release are indexed in `p1-composition-input-retirement-execution.json`. Neither finite unit executes Host/Model/Effect or package publication; both use the original 60-second/grace-5/non-Heavy guard. The final submitted HEAD adds evidence only after these actual tested sources.

Current Delta/JSON/bounded MATCH callers use WITH/GRAPH. Clean `79f2f224dd944950ecb9ef8f791ac83adcb1804f` executes JS **7/7** (`run-bWaC6C`) via `node reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/prepared-with-delta-modes.mjs`. Original typed JSON wire bytes and all Delta CIDs, selector identity, quoted bindings, default WALK, explicit WALK/TRAIL/ACYCLIC and hop0..2 remain unchanged. Complete independent Programs retain literal seed reservations. Malformed sources assert the existing common static InvalidBody/UnknownDeltaField causes. Initial cf985 **JS5/7** and later 86c373 **compile failure, zero tests executed** remain failed; allocation reasoning and raw evidence are retained in `p1-delta-mode-retirement-execution.json`. The subsequent pinned formatter changed only one assertion's whitespace; these results remain evidence of their exact tested source, not new-SHA Host success.

Clean `a75bcb8affbc1413261c5ccbfc9fe1f551be30aa` executes FULL JOIN/joined-row JS **13/13** (`run-yVSBU0`) via `node reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/prepared-with-full-row.mjs`. Source wrappers become WITH while unique-by premises, ON/USING, max10, FULL/LEFT/RIGHT/CROSS, nullable rows and ORDER remain unchanged. An independent unified complete Program follows the existing FULL chain/row-scope owner; the original staged complete Program remains a separate checked control. Initial 2454 **JS12/13** stays failed: its allocation prediction missed that FULL always enters that existing chain path. The independently traced correction changes structure only, not data, keys or constraints. Formatter, exact source/tree, receipts/hashes and actual Owner/group/ownlock release are indexed in `p1-full-row-retirement-execution.json`. Both units use 60-second/grace-5/non-Heavy guards and establish compile/check evidence only. This submitted HEAD adds tracked evidence after those fixed tested sources; no package/Host/Local/HTTPS run was performed.

Additional limited checks, each on its own clean source:

- `bb400e67f24425b7771d2a74ede42519e1baa86c`, `node reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/prepared-with-unified-source.mjs`: JS **8/8** (`run-PTnlig`) and no-change one-file formatter (`run-FlIOoB`). This is public Source API lowering, not Host execution. Exact receipts and original caller are in `p1-unified-source-retirement-execution.json` and `with-unified-source-original-caller.json`. Actual Owners/groups/ownlock were observed absent.
- `ec2a3a88bbeeef3d13ddbb161b7ddfc13f9309f8`, `node reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/prepared-with-caller-retirement.mjs`: JS **10/10**, Node **5/5** (`run-eZIUxT`).
- `67025176033a7df6221ca3130fca7504553f2e62`, `node reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/prepared-with-positional-composition.mjs`: JS **5/5**, Node **14/14** (`run-JDccH9`). These Node checks inspect independent public fixture obligations; they do not execute the Host.
- The commands' `--format` paths completed on their stated sources. The earlier whitespace-only format commit and the final evidence-only HEAD are distinct from runtime test sources. `git diff --check` passed.
- The first helper-rename compilation failure (`run-yGPamy`, no tests executed) and missing-PATH formatter `ENOENT` (`run-uhhwga`, moon not started) remain failures. Exact receipts, focused output, SHA256 and observed Owner/group/ownlock release for all six attempts are retained in `reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/p1-current-caller-retirement-execution.json`. Every attempt used the original 60-second/grace-5/non-Heavy limits.

Validation actually executed on `25fb698c0479d9764fe359b74b8ee43e07f3b11e`, tree `086a71cf04a4ebb36f19d1e014e808cad91b060f`:

- `node reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/prepared-prefix-carrier-checks.mjs`: JS **39/39**, `run-XsNte8`; actual Core public diagnostic callers and the Values Run material consumer are included. This is not Local/HTTPS Host execution.
- The same command with `--coherence`: independent Node **82/82** and read-only compilation manifests/document metadata/spec family/canonical **554 identities**, `run-IxOPUW`.
- Actual `moon info` generated the syntax interface; bounded affected-file formatter completed. The final formatter-only source `2aae93feafe945a58b01354cb18a92774fbe4901` and evidence-only submitted HEAD are distinguished from the executed source above.
- Every check used the existing **60-second / grace-5 / non-Heavy** guard. Actual Owners/groups/own locks were observed released. All original failures and exact commands are retained with SHA256 in `reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/p2-typed-carrier-prefix-execution.json`.

Earlier `0ebb` JS25/25 + Node7/7 and the original common Prefix results remain evidence for their own fixed sources. They are not reclassified as results of this HEAD. The submitted HEAD has no hosted check runs (`statusCheckRollup: []`); this is unexecuted, not PASS. No hosted CI, full Core, all-target runtime, new package producer or Heavy acceptance was started.

**Draft / incomplete:** remaining current DATA callers and examples; remaining adopted P2 adapters; four-Carrier/prefix/public SQL/AQL-text/README Local/HTTPS acceptance with a coherent package cohort. The existing **119 supplied / 130 complete IDs** and original failure conditions remain unchanged. INFER/full Debug completion is not a prerequisite. Historical sources/receipts are immutable. This PR does not claim full syntax migration or public execution completion.


Current public expansion fixture closure (no product implementation changes):

- Six existing UNNEST/UNPIVOT public source fixtures use WITH wrappers. Frozen full authored exports verify unchanged JSON controls, rows, ordered schemas, nullability, duplicate multiplicity, JOIN ceilings4/10, ASSERT UNIQUE and Source read/session counts.
- Actual normal-source lowering: fifteen cases passed at `6c40cf430c348779e90802e1032dfa401767e88e`; that aggregate remains failed15/16 because the additional Catalog negative expected the wrong order cause. Do not report it as a successful aggregate.
- At clean `7ce656021078e3a5905f971baf218899afb8c742`, `node reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/prepared-with-expansion-public.mjs --order-gap-only` passes JS1/1, and `--fixtures-only` passes Node35/35. The independently derived Catalog cause is stage1 PipelineOrder(UnresolvedOrder), preserving required operation input order. Normal acquired-source lowering uses exact-row existing Values as a local typing control only; actual standard Host acquisition remains unexecuted.
- The subsequent pinned one-file formatter changes only assertion whitespace. All thirteen raw attempts, source/tree, commands, SHA256 and actual Owner/group/ownlock absence are retained in `p1-expansion-public-retirement-execution.json`. Legacy-context and incorrect-oracle failures remain failures.
- Root five-caller full handoff is received and copied byte-for-byte with SHA256; its sourcebc738 JS28/28 and release evidence remain Root results on that source.
- No package producer, Heavy, public Local/HTTPS, Native/Wasm runtime or Hosted CI executed for this closure. Draft remains; remaining current caller retirement and adopted full P2/four-Carrier public cutover are not complete.
